description: Get the email address anyone (a person, a service, or another agent) can write to so the message lands in this company's Sequenzy inbox. Also returns the default address, the branded address (customAddress, with status active or pending), whether receiving is on, whether attachments are stored, and how many days messages are kept. Replies to Sequenzy emails arrive in the same inbox automatically.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

name: get_inbox_address

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `get_inbox_address` MCP tool.

inbox.description: Inbox address, custom-domain addresses, receiving state, attachment availability and retention.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.
